text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: When {0} was walking through the town──
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}が街中を歩いていると──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Capture Net──
ToriTori Monchichi No.2, Launch♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
捕獲ネット──
とりとりもんちっち２号、
発射ー♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♡ Capture complete~♡
Got Zako Onii-san~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひっ♡　
捕獲かんりょー♡
ザコお兄さんゲットー♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?
Getting caught by the same trap again,
you're the weakest of the weak♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
てーかマジ？
おんなじワナでまた捕まっちゃうとかぁ、
危機感
ザコおぶザコ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
And slipping and falling head first, so lame♡
So uncool♡
Wait...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかもスベって頭からコケるとか、
だっさぁ♡
カッコわるぅ～い♡
って……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
...Oni-san? Hey?
Even with all this taunting, aren't you reacting?
If you're frustrated, say something back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おにーさーん？　
お～い？
こんな煽られ倒してんのに、
リアクションうすいよ～？
悔しかったら何か言い返したら～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're not moving...?
Did you faint?
...Or maybe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
動かない……？
気絶しちゃった？
……それとも……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Z-Za Zako Onii-san! Stop with the cold jokes!
Playing dead doesn't trend anymore!
Come on, come on, wake up! Get u~p!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ザ、
ザコお兄さんっ！　
サムい冗談やめろし～っ！
死んだフリとか
マジ流行らんから！
ほらほら
起きて起きて！　
お～き～て～！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
...Uh oh.
Uh oh uh oh...!
Zako Onii-san isn't moving at all...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……やば。
やばばば……！
ザコお兄さんピクリともしないんですけど……！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
This isn't just Zako anymore, it's a disaster!
And is that a flash?
This is so confusing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これじゃザコ通り越して活〆だって～！
てか
なんかピカってね？
もうワケわかんな～いっ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Everything's going blank!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくは
目の前が真っ白になっちゃぁ～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
One day.
{0} was standing in line
to collect a popular sweet they won in a lottery.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日。
{0}は、
抽選販売で当たった
人気スイーツを受け取るため、
列に並んでいた。

text_block_list.name: Customers who Lined up First
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ I'm glad♪
I got the limited-edition menu!
I can live again tomorrow~
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～
良かった♪
新作の限定メニューゲットできて！
これで明日も生きられる～

text_block_list.name: Customer From Behind
text_block_list.text:
Darn it~, is it too late if I start lining up now?
I didn't think it would become such a buzz so suddenly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっそ～、
今から並んだんじゃ間に合わないか？
こんな急にバズり散らかすなんて思わないじゃんよ～……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And after a while.
{0} was able to get the limited sweets
just before they sold out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして、
しばらく後。
{0}は売り切れ直前で、
限定スイーツを受け取ることができた。

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~
There's dry ice in there, so be careful♪
── Today's limited sweets are now sold out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございましたー
ドライアイス入ってますので
気を付けてくださいね♪
──これにて
本日分の限定スイーツは
完売になりま～す！

text_block_list.text:
What!?
Sold out, seriously!?
I can't believe this, I went out of my way to get here...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～！？
売り切れとかマジありえないんですけど～！
このぼくが、
わざわざ遠出してきてやったってのに～っ！

text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey
Store clerk, come on~♡
There's gotta be a little material left, right? Sell it to me♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね～ね～
店員のお姉さん
おねが～い♡
ちょっとくらい材料とか残ってるっしょ？　
売って♡　
売って～♡

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Sorry~
There's really nothing left...
Come again! You're cute, so I'll give you a little extra next time~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
ごめんね～
もうほんとに、
なんにもなくって……
また来てね！　
お嬢ちゃんかわいいから、
サービスするね～！

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, she's making fun of me~!
I couldn't buy anything and she's
talking down to me like I'm a kid, it's seriously annoying!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわっ、
ナメてる～！
買えなかったうえに
タメ口でガキ扱いとかマジ腹立つんですけど～っ！

text_block_list.text: ──Huh?

Who?
Scary!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰？
コワッ～！！

text_block_list.text:
Help, officer!
An unknown man is suddenly talking
to a cute girl around here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
たすけてオマワリさ～ん！
かわいいオンナノコが、
いきなり知らない男の人に話しかけられてま～す！

text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Are you telling me to stop?
What should I do?♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～？
ぼくにやめろってゆ～の？
ど～しよっかな～？♡

text_block_list.text:
I might stop~ but?
In exchange...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やめたげてもい～けど～？
そのかわり……

text_block_list.text:
Hey, can I have one of those limited edition sweets you have, big brother?♡
Pretty please?♡
Pretty please?♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄さんの持ってる限定スイーツ、
ぼくに一個ちょーだい♡
ね♡
ね♡

text_block_list.text: Ehehe, here we go!♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひっ、
やっちゃぁ～♡

text_block_list.text:
......Oh, just so you know.
Normally, I wouldn't take stuff from a stranger?
But but......
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
いちおーゆっとくけどぉ。
ほんとなら、
知らん男からモノもらうとかしないよ？
でもでも……

text_block_list.text:
Somehow, big brother, you seem kind of familiar, don't you think?
It's weird~
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんかお兄さん、
知ってるよーな気がしないでもない？
ので～
へんなの～

text_block_list.text:
Hmm~
Maybe?
If you ask what I know, uh, for example......
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～
たぶん？
ナニしってるかってゆーとぉ、
た・と・え・ば……

text_block_list.text:
Like the fact that you're a total weakling, big brother♡
Kyahaha♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにーさんが、
クソザコだってコトとかー♡
きゃはは♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm Fubuki.
From 'Tenka Fubu'? There's the 'Fu' from 'Fubu,' and the 'Ki' from 'Machine' to make Fubuki♡
Nice to meet ya~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ぼくフブキ。
『てんか布武』？　
の『フブ』に、
『機械』の『キ』で布武機で～す♡
よろ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So, shall we go, big brother the weakling♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃー
イこっか、
ザコお兄さん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, somewhere out of sight, right?♡
Hehe♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
もち、
人目につかないトコにきまってるしょ～？♡
いひっ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~
This place should do, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～
このへんでいっかな～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Big brother, sit on the bench~? Come on, come on~
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄さん、
ベンチ座ってぇ～？　
ほらほら～

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ──Hehe♡
text_block_list.orig_text: ──いひ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Got ya!
Fubuki's tackle attack, boom!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スキあり！
フブキちゃんタックル、
ど～ん！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Kyahahaha♡
Letting a girl easily pin you down,
Big brother, you're really a weakling, aren't you~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃはははっ♡
オンナノコにあっさりマウント取られるとかぁ、
やっぱお兄さんザコなんだね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, time to dig in~♡
Lick♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
いっただっきま～す♡
ぺろっ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
......Oh, not you, big brother?
I'm talking about the sweets~♡
Don't misunderstand, that's gross♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
お兄さんをじゃないよ？
スイーツをで～す♡
カンチガイとかキ・モ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Eh~?
For the big brother who listened to my selfish whims~
I thought I'd show you the special sight of me eating sweets♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～？
ぼくのワガママきーてくれたお兄さんに～
ぼくがスイーツ食べるとこ、
とくとーせきで見せてあげよーと思ってぇ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Well, big brother's the one who's going to be the seat though♡
Kyahaha♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
席になるのはお兄さんのほーなんだけど♡
きゃはは♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~ Nice view♡
The sweets taste the best while looking down on big brother the weakling♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～
イイ眺め♡
ザコお兄さんを見下ろしながらたべるスイーツ
さいこ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, big brother, do you want some?
It was originally yours, after all,
If you can beg nicely, I'll share a little~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇねぇ、
お兄さんも食べたい？
もともとはお兄さんのなんだしぃ、
じょーずにおねだりできたら、
ちょっとわけたげるよ～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Ehe♡
You're so honest♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひ♡
素直でヨロシイ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped~♡
Then I'll let the melted part of the ice cream
Drip into your mouth♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
しょーがないな～♡
それじゃ～
アイスのとけたとこ、
お兄さんのお口に
ぽたぽた垂らしてあげるね♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, don't hold back~
We're buddies, big brother and I, ain't we? I mean, I don't know but♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
も～、
エンリョすんなっての～
お兄さんとぼくのナカじゃん、
しらんけど♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll let the melted part of the ice cream
Drip into your mouth♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ～
アイスのとけたとこ、
お兄さんのお口に
ぽたぽた垂らしてあげるね♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Drip♡
Drip-drop♡
Drippity-drop~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぽた♡
ぽーた♡
ぽたたたた～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
How is it?
Tasty?♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
どぉ～？
おいしい？♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Kyahahaha♡
Getting happy over something like this, big brother, you're such a pervert~♡
Should I call the cops for real~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃはははっ♡
こんなんで喜んじゃうとかぁ、
お兄さんマジへんたいじゃ～ん♡
やっぱオマワリさんよんだほーがい～かも～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Eh~ What should I do~?
The weak perverted big brother,
Going to the jail might be for world peace, don't you think?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～、
ど～しよっかな～？
ザコザコへんたいお兄さんはぁ、
ブタ箱行っといたほ～が
世界へーわのタメじゃね～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Don't you at least resist a little?
Oh, are you actually happy being pinned down by me?
Wow, that's creepy~lol
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってかお兄さん、
少しはテーコーとかしないのぉ？
あ、
ひょっとしてぼくに乗っかられて喜んじゃってるとかぁ？
うわ～
ドンビキ～ｗｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Hm......
Did you really think you could remove me like that?
Are you perhaps trying to be gentle so I won't get hurt?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んっ……
そ、
そんなんでぼくをどかせると思ってるのぉ？
もしかして、
ケガさせないよーにとか思って
テカゲンしてるぅ？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, too bad~lol
Even like this, I'm quite strong~♡
I lift heavy parts and tools when working with mechanics~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひっ、
残念でした～ｗ
ぼく、
これでも結構チカラつよつよなので～♡
メカいじりは
重いパーツとか
工具運ぶし～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm......
It's pointless, I said~lol
From now on, big brother the weakling is determined to be my chair forever~lol
text_block_list.orig_text:
むっ……
ムダ、
だって～のｗ
ザコお兄さんはこれから一生、
ぼくのイス決定なのでｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, whoa, wait, just a bit......!
Stop flailing~!
The ice cream will drop, the ice cream will drop~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
わっ、
ちょっ、
ちょっと……！
暴れんなし～！
落ちちゃう、
アイス落ちちゃうから～っ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah~
text_block_list.orig_text: あっ──

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Alright, good job well done~
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い、
お疲れさまぁ～

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Hey~?
Are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね～ぇ？
ちょっとあんた、
大丈夫ぅ？

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
About what, you ask? Look. The dream just now.
Yet again, it was a fate I prepared seemingly for you guys
who have no IRL acquaintances......
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナニがって、
ホラ。
今の夢。
例によって、
現実で面識ないあんたたちの出逢いを
あたしがそれっぽく用意してあげたヤツなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
That Fubuki kid was way too harsh, huh~
For her to insult you like that, right~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのフブキってコ、
いくらなんでもヒドいわよね～
あんたのこと、
あんなボロクソゆうなんてさ～？

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did it hurt your feelings?
For today only, how about I comfort you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
あんたも傷ついたわよね？
今日だけトクベツに……
あたしが
慰めてあげよっか？

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: N·o ♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
や・
ぁ・
だ♡

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Please, like I'd do something as comforting as that!
There's no way I would♡ Stupid♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはははっ！
なーにがお願いしますよ
やーよ
あんた慰めるなんて！
あたしがそんなことするワケねーっての♡　
ば～か♡

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Well?
It's like, I couldn't help but feel a little competitive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まー？
あたし的にも、
ちょっと対抗意識出ちゃった
ってゆーかぁ。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
I can't let a newcomer outdo me
when it comes to teasing you, right?
Because......
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたをからかうことにかけちゃ、
新参者に負けるわけにはいかないもんね？
だっ
て……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Really, is that so?
You're okay with it?
Then──
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～
ホント？
平気だったの？
それじゃ──

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
──So you were happy, after all?
You enjoyed being called weakling?
Getting excited from being pinned by a kid, oh my.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──あんたやっぱ、
喜んでたのね？
ザコザコ言われてうれしかったワケね？
ガキにマウントとられてコーフンしちゃってたんだ
うーわ。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this pervert. Max-level suspicious person.
……Huh? Wait so, did you think my usual teasing was a treat for you? ......Oh my god......
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～
このヘンタイ。
レベルカンスト不審者。
……ん？　
てかそんじゃ、
あんた
あたしが普段から
からかってやったのも
ご褒美とか思ってたワケ？　
……うーわぁ……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever.
So, we're in a win-win relationship♡
Got it, got it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まー
いっか。
そんじゃ、
あたしたちは
Win-Winのカンケー
ってことよね♡
そっかそっかー

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Then, from now on, whenever I appear in your dreams, I'll prank you as much as I want♡
So much that little miss won't even leave an impression.
Because......
text_block_list.orig_text:
なら、
これからも夢に出るたび、
めーいっぱいからかって
あ・
げ・
る♡
あんなメスガキ、
記憶に残らないくらいにね。
だっ
て……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: I'm the only one allowed to play with you as my toy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたをオモチャにして遊んでいいのは、
あたしだけなんだから。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Ah.
I'm not being all lovey-dovey, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ。
デレてねーわよ？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, weakling brother!
You're alive......!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ザコお兄さん！
生きてたぁ……！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Haa~ that's a relief~
If you died, what would I do...
──not that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～
良かったぁ～
しんじゃってたらどーしよって思っ……
──じゃなくって！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Geez, getting knocked out from just a little fall, your skull is too weak!
And you wouldn't wake up for a while either!
Were you having a really good dream or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
も～、
ちょっとコケただけで気絶するとか
頭蓋骨ザコザコすぎ～！
しかもなかなか目ぇ覚まさないし！
よっぽどイイ夢でも見てたってーの？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
What~?
You want to be teased even in your dreams? Just how weak are you, big brother~lol
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～？
夢の中でも煽られたいとかぁ、
ザコお兄さんどんだけ～ｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped~♡
